# Voice Changer

Voice changer: change the voice of a recording from your MegaScenes library to one of the ready-made voices, keeping its words, timing and emotion. It never copies a real person's voice.

## What it does
Pick a recording from your MegaScenes library and choose one of the library voices. Claude tells you the price, which follows the length of the recording, and makes the new version.

**How the files are made:** each voice change is generated by an audio model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Library voices only: it does not copy or imitate the voice of a real or famous person.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install voice-changer@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Voice Changer talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/voice-changer/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each voice change uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The new recording plays in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the link.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_voice_change_models` | Models for voice changes with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_voice_change_cost` | Exact price of one voice change before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_voice_change` | Starts one voice change in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_voice_change` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_media` | Your recordings and tracks, uploads and files made here, with their length, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Change the voice of my latest MegaScenes recording to a deep narrator"
- "Which voices can I use for my voice note?"
- "Make my last recording sound like a warm female narrator"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the voice change (the recording you pick from your library and the voice you choose) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
